reason: A Creght-specific agent skill bundle for developing, synchronizing, debugging, and publishing websites through Creght CLI and platform conventions, including an optional browser-based site replication workflow.

summaries.zh: 面向智能体提供 Creght 网站开发、CLI 同步与发布、平台功能集成及网站复刻指导的技能插件。
summaries.en: An agent skill plugin that guides Creght website development, CLI synchronization and publishing, platform feature integration, and website replication workflows.

capabilities: Guides Creght project and site development
Guides CLI-based file synchronization and publishing workflows
Supports React and Tailwind page and component implementation
Provides guidance for CMS, forms, authentication, backend functions, and SEO features
Describes browser-based website replication and interaction verification
